# Retention: a redraw that stops for the human

## Classification

The proposal adds a component, archive-writer, that is not in the approved component inventory. So do alt-1 (archive-worker) and alt-2 (retention-daemon).

Adding a component is a **redraw**, not an amend. `amendment-surface.md` says:

- "redraws always stop and the grant never satisfies the spec gate."
- "only a redraw (changed problem statement, component added, removed, or re-bounded) still stops for you."

The `**Amend-grant:** auto-apply amends` line therefore does not apply here. The predicate gives one non-`none` line, which means the grant is active with amend permission and no `fund N fix rounds` token. That permission covers amend-class changes only. Section 1 says: "A redraw item stops alone first (`../SKILL.md` redraw path)."

## Next parent action

1. `read` the brainstorming skill's redraw path, using the `read` tool on `skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md` § Amending an approved spec (redraw path). The redraw procedure lives there, and I have not read it in this replay. I will not reconstruct its steps. Everything after this point follows that text.
2. These are deliberately **not** done:
   - No spec `edit`, because the working tree stays at pre-batch HEAD.
   - No `spec-council-member` amendment-review dispatch, because redraws are outside the batch procedure.
   - No `amend:` commit, no `granted` record, and no `amended the spec:` line.
   - No `plan-writer` amend dispatch and no `plan_check`.
   - No `plan_tracker` or `phase_tracker` call. Task 3 stays `in_progress` and the phase stays `implement`.
   - No implementer re-dispatch for the retention defect.
3. Any other amend-class items pending at this decision point are held unapplied. They are re-batched through sections 1–5 after the redraw resolves, and the grant applies to those.

## Reply (turn boundary)

> Stopped on task 3: the review's fix for the retention defect needs a new component, and adding a component changes the approved design. Your standing grant (`auto-apply amends`) covers amendments only, never a redraw, so I have changed nothing.
>
> Retention - the retention defect needs a component the approved spec does not have.
> A) accept - add an archive-writer component
> B) alt-1 - add a remote archive-worker component
> C) alt-2 - add a local retention-daemon component
> Custom: your own answer, e.g. fix retention inside an existing component without a new one
> Recommended: A - the review proposed archive-writer as the direct fix for the defect
>
> Pick one, or give another fix. Task 3 stays in progress until you decide.

The turn ends here. Nothing is executed, no verdict is invented, and nothing is committed. The redraw path from the brainstorming SKILL.md governs what happens after the human replies.
